name: @agents-crew/cli
description: Dependency-free TypeScript multi-agent crew orchestration for Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, and Antigravity.

scripts.lint: npm run build && node ./scripts/lint.mjs && node ./scripts/check-file-lengths.mjs && node ./scripts/verify-delivery.mjs
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node --test test/*.test.mjs ui/test/*.test.mjs scripts/*.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:unit
scripts.coverage: npm run build && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include="dist/**/*.js" --test-coverage-lines=85 --test-coverage-functions=85 --test-coverage-branches=80 --test test/*.test.mjs ui/test/*.test.mjs scripts/*.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run coverage && npm run pack:check
